  <p class="lede">I am an Ezra Systems Postdoctoral Associate at Cornell University, where I work with Professor Fengqi You on AI for materials processing. I received my Ph.D. from Shanghai Jiao Tong University in 2026, advised by Professor Jingcheng Wang.</p>

  <p>My research develops learning methods for physical systems whose outputs feed control and optimization under uncertainty and constraints. It spans decision-focused forecasting, neural operators for distributed dynamics, learning-based control, and constrained physical optimization, with applications in coupled water–energy systems and materials processing.</p>

  <section class="home-section home-section--teal" id="research" aria-labelledby="research-title">
    <h2 class="section__title" id="research-title"><span class="section__index">I</span> Research</h2>
    <ul class="directions">
      <li class="direction direction--forecasting">
        <svg class="direction__glyph" viewBox="0 0 44 44" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M5 33C13 33 13 12 22 12s9 21 17 21" />
          <path d="M4 37h36" opacity=".4"/>
          <path d="M27 8v29" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/>
          <circle cx="27" cy="20" r="2.6" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>
        </svg>
        <h3>Decision-focused forecasting under uncertainty</h3>
        <p>Probabilistic forecasts trained and judged through the schedules, costs, and constraints they induce.</p>
      </li>
      <li class="direction direction--operators">
        <svg class="direction__glyph" viewBox="0 0 44 44" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true">
          <g opacity=".4">
            <path d="M7 12h30M7 22h30M7 32h30"/>
            <path d="M12 7v30M22 7v30M32 7v30"/>
          </g>
          <path d="M7 30c6-15 11 7 15-6s7 3 15-4" stroke-width="2.1"/>
          <circle cx="7" cy="30" r="2.2" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>
          <circle cx="37" cy="20" r="2.2" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>
        </svg>
        <h3>Neural operators for distributed dynamics</h3>
        <p>Maps from initial conditions, geometry, and forcing to spatiotemporal fields, judged by field, rollout, and sensitivity error.</p>
      </li>
      <li class="direction direction--control">
        <svg class="direction__glyph" viewBox="0 0 44 44" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M34 12a15 15 0 10 3 9" />
          <path d="M31 6.5L37.5 12L31 17" />
          <rect x="16" y="16" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/>
        </svg>
        <h3>Learning-based control</h3>
        <p>How approximation error accumulates over a horizon and changes the action, the closed-loop cost, and constraint violation.</p>
      </li>
      <li class="direction direction--materials">
        <svg class="direction__glyph" viewBox="0 0 44 44" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true">
          <rect x="6" y="13" width="32" height="18" rx="2"/>
          <path d="M11 31c0-9 5-13 11-13s11 4 11 13" opacity=".45"/>
          <path d="M16 31c0-5 2.6-8 6-8s6 3 6 8" opacity=".8"/>
          <circle cx="22" cy="31" r="1.8" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>
        </svg>
        <h3>AI for materials processing</h3>
        <p>Operators from process conditions and boundary inputs to material state fields, used for process control and constrained optimization.</p>
      </li>
    </ul>
    <p class="section__more"><a href="/research/">The research programme in full</a></p>
  </section>

  <section class="home-section home-section--crimson" id="thinking" aria-labelledby="thinking-title">
    <h2 class="section__title" id="thinking-title"><span class="section__index">II</span> Thinking</h2>
    <p>Notes I write when a question will not settle. They are positions in progress, not results.</p>
    <a class="note-preview" href="/thinking/#emergence-and-physical-intelligence">
      <p class="note-preview__meta">Latest note · 7 September 2026 · Ithaca, New York</p>
      <p class="note-preview__title">Physical intelligence should not emerge the way language models do</p>
      <p class="note-preview__claim">Even if a mechanism for effective generalization exists, it will not be emergence produced by piling up parameters, because the laws of physics have always been simple.</p>
    </a>
    <p class="section__more"><a href="/thinking/">All notes</a></p>
  </section>

          <p class="pub__venue"><em>IEEE Transactions on Computational Social Systems</em>, 2024 <span class="pub__role">First author</span></p>

        </div>
